title: Singapore says trade through Malacca Strait must remain free
desc: Singapore’s Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan said passage through the straits of Malacca and Singapore, a key trade chokepoint brought into focus by the war in Iran, must remain free for all and that the city-state won’t support any efforts to restrict it.

title: Community mourns as road rage victim begins final journey to Pakistan
desc: Mourners gathered at Westpark Cemetery to pay their respects to 48-year-old Zawar Faisal ul Rehman who was killed in a road rage incident on Sunday.

title: "China's Client": Former US NSA Questions Pak's Role In Iran Talks
desc: Washington, April 22 (IANS) Former US National Security Advisor (NSA) H.R. McMaster has cast doubt on Pakistan’s role in Iran-related diplomacy, describing it as a “client” of China and warning of “ulterior motives” in its mediation efforts.

title: Mother, Child Drown in Lake Bunyonyi Canoe Accident

The deceased, identified only as Joyous and her child, were residents of Kagugo-Murungu Village in Kitooma Parish, Rubaya Sub-county. title: Asia Piling named for hitting fibre-optic cables that led to 20-hour broadband disruption
desc: Asia Piling Co is the sub-contractor that hit critical underground fibre optic cables, causing a 20-hour broadband outage in Singapore on April 18. Read more at straitstimes.com.

title: The Methodist bishop's message that led to him and his elders being called 'thieves' by a member
desc: The bishop of Wesley Cathedral Methodist Church in Sunyani and its elders were labelled as “thieves” in church by a female member.

title: Refund sped up to cushion Meralco users from higher rates
desc: Meralco customers will see bigger bill deductions over the next 12 months after the Energy Regulatory Commission ordered the accelerated refund of ₱14.17 billion in distribution charges, raising the average refund rate to ₱0.2511/kWh to provide faster relief amid rising power costs.

title: iPhone 18 may have lower specs and a delayed launch, rumor says
desc: A new iPhone 18 rumor speculates that Apple is downgrading the base model's specs and will launch it next year.
